args.title: Corvid Packaging: Warehouse automation in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter: Corvid Packaging's latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026."
- Article (blog.corvid.example/2026/warehouse): Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/warehouse/companion): The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
